en.title: Invitation
lines: "Rồng rắn lên mây!" {name}, you be the head of the dragon!
Swipe to turn and pick up more friends, but never loop into your own line.

choices.text: Up into the clouds we go!

en.text: The hilltop is still breezy, and I will wait for our next dragon game.
